title: Japan Unveiled | A Journey Through Time and Innovation
highlights: Experience Japan’s blend of tradition and modernity, from serene temples in Osaka to Tokyo’s futuristic skyline.
Admire the grand architecture of the Tokyo Imperial Palace, a royal retreat amid bustling Tokyo where historic elegance meets modernity.
Soak-in the views of Mount Fuji during your cruise on the Ashi Lake, formed by the eruption of Mount Hakone around 3,000 years ago.
Witness Ebisu Bridge, a bustling landmark in Dotonbori known for its Glico Man sign and lively street scenes.
Enjoy the thrill and stunning vistas as you glide through the sky on the Hakone Ropeway, with panoramic views of volcanic landscapes and Mount Fuji.
overview:
About the Budget Tour to Japan in 6 Days:
Embark on an incredible journey through Japan, starting in Tokyo. Explore the city's cultural gems, lush gardens, and vibrant shopping scenes. Take in the beauty of Mount Fuji and Lake Hakone before heading to Osaka, a city that beautifully combines modernity, cultural heritage, and delicious cuisine. Dive into Japan's rich history and traditions with an unforgettable trip to Nara and Kyoto, where you'll visit historic treasures like Nijo Castle, the stunning Golden Pavilion (Kinkaku-Ji), and Todai-Ji Temple. As your adventure draws to a close, you'll bid farewell to Japan, carrying with you cherished memories of a remarkable journey filled with cultural discoveries, breathtaking landscapes, and modern wonders.
Quick Info.
Route: Tokyo - Mt. Fuji - Hakone -Osaka
Duration: 6 days & 5 nights 
Start point: Tokyo International Airport
Endpoint: Itami Airport

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, get driven to the hotel in Tokyo. After check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can leisurely stroll at Yoyogi Park or visit Sumida Park & enjoy the view of the Sumida River with Tokyo Skytree in the background. Also, you can indulge in shopping in the vibrant Ginza District, which offers a variety of options. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, head to the pick-up point, Matsuya Ginza, and board the bus to explore Tokyo. Start the tour by visiting the Meiji Shrine, a Shinto shrine offering a peaceful atmosphere. Next, visit the Imperial Palace and admire its stunning architecture, reflecting the historical grandeur of Japan. Then, pay your respects at Sensō-ji, Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, and visit many more attractions. Post-tour, get driven back to Matsuya Ginza, and from there, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Day Trip To Mount Fuji and Hakone
days.desc: Today, head to Shinjuku Love on your own and board your transfer to the majestic Mount Fuji. Once there, ascend to the Subaru Line 5th Station for stunning views of Japan's highest peak. Next, enjoy a scenic cruise across Lake Ashi with views of Mount Fuji. Continue with a ride on the Hakone Ropeway, and later, explore the Owakudani Valley, known for its volcanic activity. Post-tour, get driven to Odawara Station & take a bullet train back to Tokyo Station, then return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, after check-out, head to Tokyo Station on your own and board the Shinkansen bullet train to Osaka (tickets included). Upon arrival, head to your hotel on your own and check-in. Spend the rest of your day at your leisure, where you can explore the Osaka Museum of Housing and Living to delve into the city’s history or visit the Osaka Science Museum for interactive exhibits. Also, discover the lively Den Den Town, a hotspot for anime enthusiasts. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the meeting point, the Hotel Hankyu Respire, for a guided walking tour of Osaka. Begin the tour in the vibrant district of Dotonbori and wander through this lively area. Next, visit the Ebisu Bridge, an iconic landmark, and continue to Hozenji Yokocho, a narrow alleyway lined with traditional shops. Also, visit the Hozenji Temple and many more attractions. Later, from Higashi-Umeda Station, you can explore Dotonbori Zaza, Tennoji Park, & more before returning to your hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Kansai International Airport, where your Japan trip comes to an end.
